name: Green Light Cafe & Deli
notes: 5 photos: 1-3 are an overhead wall board, 4-5 are a printed tri-fold menu (same restaurant, printed name 'Green Light Cafe & Deli' visible on 5.jpg). Prices and some item names differ between the two versions (e.g. Hot Sandwiches $8.50 on the board vs $8.00 on the paper menu); used the paper tri-fold as the single consistent source and did not merge in the board's conflicting prices. Skipped the build-your-own 'Pick a Deli Sandwich' and 'Wrap It Up' sections (components, not fixed dishes).
